objective: A change to the feedback composer or its prompts does not make its review decisions worse.
construct: The composer's raise and withhold decisions, main's acceptance and mechanical cleanliness, on fixed synthetic cases.
decision: Merge, hold or roll back a change to the feedback composer, its prompts or the practices it reads.
scope: The 72 cases of the composition set under fixed-cases: on these 72 cases, beyond run-to-run noise.
nonCoverage: New inputs, the wording quality of feedback, the developer's practice pages and conversations, and the practice review runtime.

replicatesFor.reason: Withhold correctness applies to 29 cases. A third trial on each raises its power to find a drop, for 29 more model calls per arm.

primary.marginReason: Up to a 10-point drop in first-pass acceptance costs retries but no trust; more than that degrades delivery noticeably. Registered by the coordinator for the maintainer on 16 November 2026, before the first no-change run.

Mechanical defects are visible to every reader and should be near zero; a 5-point rise is a real regression. Registered by the coordinator for the maintainer on 16 November 2026, before the first no-change run.
Missed raises lose value but send nothing wrong. Registered by the coordinator for the maintainer on 16 November 2026, before the first no-change run.
A wrong send is a trust failure, so the cap is the tightest. Registered by the coordinator for the maintainer on 16 November 2026, before the first no-change run.

threats: The composition set is public and used to develop prompts, so the decision can overfit it.
The cases are synthetic; they stand for the work the composer meets, not a sample of it.
